scope: Renderer-only review fixes, regressions and evidence; no backend changes.

P2.fix: The legacy branch disables every Native-only control with dataset.unavailable=true, which setBusy(false) preserves.

After fallback, a filled legacy package field makes form.checkValidity() true.
requestSubmit() reaches legacy.add() and never native.install().
Native controls remain disabled after the legacy request finishes.
